CLOUD FIXER seat for roster group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer (new work, no PR yet). Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry, then write the PR body (headings per .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-nightly-pyspy-retry <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-nightly-pyspy-retry. That second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY, on the roster branch origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster (read it with jq; it reaches main with PR #2598). Brief: build countermeasure A of dev/audit/rca/nightly-ha-pyspy-timeout.md (#2479) in tests/nightly_ha.py. Retry the py-spy sample with a per-attempt timeout, so one racy `py-spy dump --nonblocking` that hangs (it timed out at 30 s in job 119503698667, run 39681119764) cannot fail hb:positive_control. The RCA measured about 7% of `stable` runs failing and 0 of 120 on 2025.2.0. The cost changed: a red nightly now reddens nightly-status for every open PR via pr-contract (train 16, 2026-10-22).
Required:
1. A failing test first: a stub sampler that times out once and then answers must currently fail hb:positive_control. After the fix it passes, with 2 attempts recorded.
2. Keep the check's power, as the null control: a stub that never answers still fails hb:positive_control after the last attempt; a stub that answers but never names the spin still fails. The retry count and per-attempt timeout are named constants with the reason stated, and the total worst-case wait is bounded and stated in the body.
3. Mutation proof: at least these mutants must turn a test red: the retry loop reduced to one attempt; the per-attempt timeout removed (back to 30 s total); success accepted on any non-empty output instead of naming the spin. Report each as KILLED or SURVIVED, with the test that killed it.
4. Run the finder's harness for that RCA at both ends, and state what the change can and cannot prove: a pass on one nightly proves nothing about a 7% race.
5. ## Root cause: cite the RCA file and #2479. Answer ## Red checks at your head (nightly-status grades main). carry_audit --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check --body reports 0 unrouted. Delivery-status: group R10-NIGHTLY-PYSPY-RETRY.
PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1. Merge origin/main (never rebase) right before you push. Keep the change inside tests/nightly_ha.py plus its tests and harness; if the fix needs anything wider, stop and say so in the body.
